name: p6-F.3-watch-linux
title: Part 6, how it works: read CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalogue (count, one AI tool's entry, the AI tools on it) and two OSV advisories, one exploited and one fixed but not on the list

steps.label: One entry
steps.type: jq '.vulnerabilities[] | select(.cveID=="CVE-2026-55255") | {cveID, vulnerabilityName, dateAdded, dueDate}' kev.json

steps.label: Advisory
steps.type: curl -sS https://api.osv.dev/v1/vulns/GHSA-qrpv-q767-xqq2 | jq '{id, aliases, published, fixed: [.affected[].ranges[]?.events[]? | .fixed // empty]}'

steps.label: Fixed only
steps.type: curl -sS https://api.osv.dev/v1/vulns/GHSA-3c86-2m5g-59q7 | jq '{id, aliases, summary, fixed: [.affected[].ranges[]?.events[]? | .fixed // empty]}'
